subject: Environmental Information Regulations 2004 - F261029 and Freedom of Information request - F261030
source: Original email in the family's Gmail (read-only export); contact details redacted.
text:
Dear Sion Buckler

Thank you for your email dated 20 October 2026.

Your request will be dealt with under the:

Environmental Information Regulations 2004 - reference F261029
Freedom of Information Act 2000 - reference F261030.

Our statutory deadline for reply for F261029 and F261030 is 17 November 2026 but we will endeavour to respond as soon as possible.

Yours sincerely


S Henderson
Disclosure Officer (Risk, Assurance, Information, Security)
Data and Register Integrity Group
Email- [email redacted]<[email redacted]>
GOV.UK<https://www.gov.uk/government/organisations/land-registry> | @HMLandRegistry<https://twitter.com/HMLandRegistry> | LinkedIn<http://www.linkedin.com/company/land-registry> | Facebook





HM Land Registry's purpose is to protect your land ownership and provide services and data that underpin an efficient and informed property market. Our vision is: "A world-leading property market as part of a thriving economy and a sustainable future".

We check all mail and attachments for known viruses. However, you are advised that you open any attachments at your own risk. If you have received this email and it was not intended for you, please let us know, then delete it.

We welcome correspondence in English and Welsh.

To see how HM Land Registry treats your personal information, read our Personal information charter: www.gov.uk/government/organisations/land-registry/about/personal-information-charter.
